verdict.rationale: Content management of pages, blogs, and media alongside products is a fair question for an ecommerce platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence of it. The cited APIs cover products, orders, customers, and store settings, and theme or headless tooling (Stencil, Catalyst, GraphQL Storefront API) is about building storefronts, not managing content in the admin.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can manage content — pages, blogs, media — alongside my products from the same admin
